### Affected Component
- [ ] Specification (`spec/`)
- [ ] Scripts / Automation (`scripts/`)
- [ ] Port: (e.g. `ports/vscode`, `ports/obsidian`, `ports/alacritty`, `ports/kitty`, `ports/neovim`, `ports/windows-terminal`)

### Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

### Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen according to the spec (`spec/palette.json`, `spec/rules.md`, `spec/token-map.md`).

### Contrast / Color Details (if applicable)
- Mode: (Day / Evening / Night)
- Element / Token:
- Measured Contrast Ratio:
- Expected Ratio (WCAG AA/AAA):

### Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

### Environment
- OS: [e.g. macOS, Windows, Linux]
- Application Version: [e.g. VS Code 1.90, Obsidian 1.6.5]
- Circadia Version:
